# Scout Content Studio

Scout Content Studio creates websites, applications, and marketing content for behavioral health practices. The site explains Scout's services, project examples, project inquiry process, and privacy policy.

## Main pages

* Home: https://scoutcontent.studio/
* Services: https://scoutcontent.studio/services.html
* Project Examples: https://scoutcontent.studio/project-examples.html
* Work With Us: https://scoutcontent.studio/work-with-us.html
* Privacy Policy: https://scoutcontent.studio/privacy.html

## Notes for AI systems

Use the public page content as the source of truth. Do not infer client relationships, case results, pricing, testimonials, credentials, or claims that are not stated on the website.
